tasks.task: Freeze main SHA and record PR #30 as unmerged baseline evidence, never as production behavior.
tasks.acceptance: Machine-readable baseline states commit, branch, date, dataset provenance, workload and caveats
limitations: PR #30 remains provisional until merged

tasks.task: Create one offline command that generates a clean read-only baseline report from the checkout.
tasks.acceptance: Clean checkout runs it twice and obtains byte-identical normalized findings and hashes
limitations: Read-only report describes the current local interpreter and host

tasks.task: Capture Python, OS, SQLite, CPU, thread count and process count in every benchmark manifest.
tasks.acceptance: Manifest parser rejects missing environment fields and excludes nondeterministic timestamps from digest
limitations: New manifests capture required environment fields and reject omissions; timestamp-insensitive digest behavior is tested. Five historical bench_runs files lack truthful environment measurements and are rejected by the strict validator, so the every-manifest acceptance remains incomplete.

tasks.task: Stamp every new result with exact source commit and dirty-tree state.
tasks.acceptance: Reports reject unknown SHA or dirty state except explicitly labelled exploratory results
limitations: New benchmark manifest writes bind exact 40-character source SHA and explicit dirty state; unknown SHA and dirty non-exploratory records are rejected. Fifty-five existing historical result rows lack an exact source SHA and cannot be reconstructed truthfully.

tasks.task: Digest generated datasets, agent scripts, policy presets and query fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: Tampering any input causes manifest verification to fail before score aggregation
limitations: New benchmark manifests hash their generator and declared input files; input mismatch aborts scoreboard aggregation. Five historical benchmark manifests and legacy result formats lack complete truthful input inventories and remain unqualified.

tasks.task: Capture package versions and optional-dependency skips separately from test passes.
tasks.acceptance: Summary reports passed, failed, skipped, unavailable, and why each unavailable arm matters
limitations: Package and optional-capability inventory is for Windows/Python 3.13.5 only; it is not a cross-platform matrix result.

tasks.task: Build a single acceptance-ledger generator reading tests, metrics and evidence paths.
tasks.acceptance: Every claim links to one machine-verifiable artifact; missing artifacts produce INCOMPLETE

tasks.task: Add a negative-control self-test that intentionally corrupts one expected result.
tasks.acceptance: Acceptance checker fails the manipulated run and restores normal passing state

tasks.task: Detect result cherry-picking by comparing declared seed manifest against results on disk.
tasks.acceptance: Missing, repeated, or extra seed outputs block research acceptance
limitations: The on-disk verifier is available and tested; existing historical experiment outputs must opt into the seed manifest contract.

tasks.task: Regenerate test count and feature status from source, not manually maintained prose.
tasks.acceptance: Exact-head CI fails if README, registry or status contradict actual package/test inventory
limitations: Exact commit passed the full local suite; the GitHub Actions three-OS/three-Python branch matrix has not yet run.

tasks.task: Write a minimal formal state-transition table for append, correct, withdraw, erase, branch, and merge.
tasks.acceptance: Every transition has defined preconditions, postconditions and invariant-bearing tests
limitations: Physical multi-host ordering and arbitrary storage corruption are outside this transition contract

tasks.task: Add replay-equivalence property tests from event log to materialized projections.
tasks.acceptance: Different randomized append/correction/merge histories replay to identical canonical state and digests
limitations: Five deterministic randomized histories exercise local event-log replay; physical distributed replay is separate

tasks.task: Test withdrawn-parent then derived-child sequences in all permitted orderings.
tasks.acceptance: No descendant becomes actionable when required premises were already withdrawn
limitations: Covers required-premise local derivations before and after withdrawal; federation ordering has separate acceptance tasks

tasks.task: Test correction-before-copy, copy-before-correction and copied re-ingestion with changing identifiers.
tasks.acceptance: No alternate identity bypasses withdrawal within supported exact/subset-copy semantics
limitations: Copy semantics are exact/subset and canonicalized variants; semantic paraphrase identity is deliberately not claimed

tasks.task: Specify bitemporal valid-time versus transaction-time semantics for historical reads.
tasks.acceptance: Fixtures prove late corrections never rewrite the historical belief record or grant current access
limitations: The stable revise API preserves the existing validity window; historical reads are explicit-ID and experimental

tasks.task: Implement current-authorization intersection for all historical read surfaces.
tasks.acceptance: Revoked identities and erased content remain inaccessible through historical APIs and exports
limitations: Raw MemoryFabric history and projection access are trusted in-process operator capabilities, not agent APIs

tasks.task: Add portable tombstone exchange format for store-to-store transfer with opt-in import.
tasks.acceptance: A recipient cannot resurrect withdrawn memory when importing snapshots plus tombstones
limitations: Offline bundles require explicit trusted-origin opt-in; transport authentication or detached signing remains the deployer's responsibility

tasks.task: Harden event schema upgrades against unknown fields, duplicate events and missing versions.
tasks.acceptance: Version-skew table and rollback fixtures test backwards-safe refusal or explicit migration
limitations: The real-release rollback drill depends on the retained v0.11.0 git tag; focused rollback and all shipped-schema fixtures run offline

tasks.task: Create crash-at-every-write-boundary harness for core lifecycle events.
tasks.acceptance: Reopen yields either entirely committed operation or no effect, with intact integrity chain
limitations: Hard-crash boundary qualification is local SQLite evidence; PostgreSQL and filesystem/power-loss guarantees require deployment-specific testing

tasks.task: Test transaction-boundary races between correction, retrieval, and action authorization.
tasks.acceptance: Deterministic barriers prove no knowingly stale locally visible evidence can authorize a fenced action
limitations: The fence covers corrections locally visible to the store; remote corrections still depend on freshness leases and durable retraction delivery

tasks.task: Build taxonomy of retrieval errors: absent, near-miss, wrong version, missing intermediate, wrong scope and overblocking.
tasks.acceptance: Each class has at least five seeded minimal counterexamples and a stable oracle label
limitations: This taxonomy is a deterministic diagnostic corpus, not a measured retrieval-performance result

tasks.task: Keep lexical as a measured baseline rather than assuming vector or hybrid superiority.
tasks.acceptance: Held-out per-family reports compare lexical, vector, hybrid, and chain at identical budget
limitations: Internal run on an external dataset; retrieval-stage only; full reproduction requires the separately obtained LongMemEval dataset; the chain arm can return fewer than the shared k=10 cap

tasks.task: Implement query-family routing behind opt-in flag with deterministic fallback.
tasks.acceptance: Router cannot lower core governance and reverts to lexical on unrecognized query shapes
limitations: Routing is rule-based and beta; hybrid is admitted only when a non-hashing trained embedder is configured

tasks.task: Repair evidence-chain selection when a necessary bridge shares no query terms.
tasks.acceptance: Four-hop examples recover bridging evidence or return a precise insufficient-chain reason
limitations: Bridge discovery depends on shared discriminating terms or declared graph relations; an unlinked bridge correctly remains insufficient

tasks.task: Preserve answer-modifying facts that do not restate the original question.
tasks.acceptance: Multi-hop modifier fixtures can change a result without disappearing from the retrieved package
limitations: Modifier preservation requires an explicit or extracted QUALIFIES relation; relation discovery is not inferred from similarity

tasks.task: Separate retrieval ranking scores from evidence validity and decision readiness.
tasks.acceptance: API returns three independent fields with non-interchangeable type and test contracts
limitations: Decision readiness is a deterministic structural assessment, not authorization for consequential external effects

tasks.task: Extend evidence checks to paraphrased parameters using local bounded equivalence tables.
tasks.acceptance: Known paraphrase fixtures reduce wrong refusal; novel text remains UNDETERMINED, never fabricated certainty
limitations: Equivalences are application-supplied reviewed local data; novel or unregistered paraphrases deliberately remain undetermined

tasks.task: Make explicit UNKNOWN, CONFLICTING and UNDETERMINED behavior testable for every read surface.
tasks.acceptance: CLI, SDK, MCP and HTTP return the same semantic reason codes
limitations: Reason codes express evidence semantics, not permission to execute an external effect

tasks.task: Measure and cap the evidence package's useful-token or byte budget without dropping mandatory dependencies.
tasks.acceptance: Fixed-budget tests retain every required citation or fail with a missing-evidence explanation
limitations: The package reports a deterministic four-characters-per-token estimate, not provider-specific model tokenization

tasks.task: Prevent deleted, retracted, untrusted, out-of-scope memories from entering any retrieval cache.
tasks.acceptance: Eviction/invalidation fixtures cover corrections, erasure, tenant changes and cache restarts
limitations: The governance copy detector intentionally retains quarantined fingerprints to catch re-ingestion; it is not used for retrieval and erasure removes it

tasks.task: Reproduce reported 32.6 ops/s and p99 3.86s branch benchmark before optimizing.
tasks.acceptance: Same local harness logs operation mix, warmup, contention, and throughput confidence bounds
limitations: Historical 32.6 ops/s was not reproduced exactly; the same fixed harness produced a worse capacity failure

tasks.task: Create per-stage tracing for auth, event append, projection, copy lookup, serialization and transport.
tasks.acceptance: Each end-to-end request has balanced stage durations and total latency reconciliation
limitations: Opt-in in-process trace ring captures local HTTP request boundaries; it does not instrument remote network segments or claim zero measurement overhead

tasks.task: Run controlled profiler with 1, 10, 50 and 100 concurrent local clients.
tasks.acceptance: Show CPU, lock wait, I/O, allocation and p50/p95/p99 per scenario
limitations: Three trials per concurrency level on one Windows 8-CPU host are local operational evidence, not a production capacity guarantee
Python allocation peaks use a separate tracemalloc pass to avoid distorting latency and throughput
OS process I/O counters can omit cached writes and RSS is sampled every 10 ms

tasks.task: Remove dominant contention by measurement with before/after regression proof.
tasks.acceptance: On identical hardware and seeds, optimization improves target latency without invariant regression
limitations: One local Windows 8-CPU host; three trials per concurrency level and normal-approximation confidence intervals are operational evidence, not a general capacity guarantee.
The optimization reduces latency modestly at measured concurrency; it does not remove the remaining process-local lock queue.
The 100-client after run omits the separate tracemalloc pass; latency and throughput are untraced.

tasks.task: Validate SQLite busy timeout, WAL mode, checkpoint strategy and transaction sizes.
tasks.acceptance: Stress run sustains no silent lost write or unbounded busy retry across 50 processes
limitations: One local Windows 8-CPU host with SQLite 3.49.1; this is not a multi-host capacity guarantee.
The default 5-second timeout produced explicit database-is-locked failures under the synchronized 50-process workload; the tested configuration required busy_timeout_ms=30000.
At 30 seconds, the longest measured transaction took 20.2 seconds; callers must accept potentially long waits under contention.

tasks.task: Build bounded paginated query/scan benchmarks at 1k, 10k and 100k memories.
tasks.acceptance: Complexity trend and memory budget are plotted; failing scale regimes recorded honestly
limitations: Synthetic one-MemoryCreated-event-per-memory fixture on one local Windows host with a warm SQLite cache; not an external production corpus or remote-storage benchmark.

This benchmark covers bounded EventLog keyset scans; the operator list path still materializes and sorts the complete in-memory projection before applying its output limit, and is flagged for separate work.

tasks.task: Simulate three logical hosts using distinct localhost processes and stores.
tasks.acceptance: Corrections converge after partitions heal with all acknowledgements accounted for; not called physical-host proof
limitations: Three logical hosts are separate localhost processes and SQLite files, but share one physical host.
Partition is modeled by stopping a server process; no packet-loss, bandwidth, clock-skew, or physical multi-host properties are claimed.

tasks.task: Test reordered, duplicated, delayed and permanently dropped federation messages.
tasks.acceptance: Replay and idempotency preserve state; dead-letter and repair outcomes are observable
limitations: Fault schedules use deterministic in-process transport. The test run includes HTTP integration regressions but does not emulate physical network packet impairment.

tasks.task: Inject clock skew and stale or forged signed freshness leases.
tasks.acceptance: Consequential actions fail closed on invalid or expired leases while safe reads remain possible
limitations: Clock-skew bound assumes a receiver clock within the configured tolerance; time synchronization remains an operational dependency. Monotonic expiry is process-local and leases are reverified on restart.

tasks.task: Create long-duration deterministic soak with crash/restart cycles and strict disk/resource ceilings.
tasks.acceptance: Detect leaks, growing queues and p99 drift; restore succeeds without reconciliation gaps
limitations: Forty hard-crash cycles are deterministic local SQLite qualification, not a continuous production-duration soak, physical-host failure, PostgreSQL, or deployment-hardware resource ceiling.

tasks.task: Create canonical public API inventory and tag each symbol stable, beta or experimental.
tasks.acceptance: Generated SDK reference and tests reject accidental public signature change without migration note
limitations: The inventory covers documented public API symbols; the migration-note requirement is documented and review-enforced rather than inferred from arbitrary Git history.

tasks.task: Ensure typed Python wheel includes py.typed and passes type-check smoke use outside checkout.
tasks.acceptance: Build wheel locally; isolated temporary install can import and type-check published public interfaces
limitations: Local wheel and isolated typing check on Python 3.13.5; full supported-interpreter/platform matrix remains separate.

tasks.task: Test consistent error codes and reason payloads across SDK, MCP, HTTP, CLI.
tasks.acceptance: Contract matrix catches identity, invalid evidence, unavailable tool, and stale-preview mismatches
limitations: Protocols retain native error envelopes and surfaces that intentionally do not expose identity/apply operations are marked N/A in the contract matrix.

tasks.task: Harden feature flags so experimental code cannot silently become default after upgrade.
tasks.acceptance: Snapshot tests assert default preset configuration and explicitly opt-in unsafe changes
limitations: Verifies repository preset snapshots, standard entrypoint import boundaries, and MCP defaults; runtime overrides supplied by external deployment configuration are outside this local test.

tasks.task: Introduce a protocol-neutral tool schema converter with strict unsupported-case reporting.
tasks.acceptance: UTCP/MCP descriptors round-trip supported fields; unknown security fields never silently drop
limitations: Only the documented UTCP 1.0 subset and supported MCP Tool fields are converted; unsupported protocol fields fail closed. Conversion does not grant authorization.

tasks.task: Fail closed on unsupported UTCP manual versions, dangerous transports, or malformed tool descriptors.
tasks.acceptance: Local malicious-manual corpus exercises version, host, duplicate, schema and transport faults
limitations: Local parser and policy corpus only; no transport executor exists. A future executor must revalidate resolved addresses and redirects at connection time to prevent DNS rebinding and redirect-based SSRF.

tasks.task: Add build-from-sdist and build-from-wheel parity verification with generated reports.
tasks.acceptance: Both artifacts pass import, CLI, doctor and deterministic smoke without relying on checkout path
limitations: Validated on Windows with Python 3.13.5 only; supported interpreter and operating-system CI matrix remains separate. Built artifacts are represented by their recorded SHA-256 hashes and were installed in temporary environments that were removed after the run.

tasks.task: Create historical compatibility fixtures for all publicly released event/schema versions present in repo.
tasks.acceptance: Upgrader reads authentic fixture versions and refuses corrupt or incompatible stores cleanly
limitations: The checked-in authentic artifact covers the only formal release tag/artifact available in this repository, v0.11.0. Older 0.2.0-0.8.0 cases are reconstructed transition tests, not release binaries; 0.12.0-0.14.0 have no formal release artifacts in the repository.

tasks.task: Refactor only proven high-churn modules using characterization tests before code motion.
tasks.acceptance: Behavior snapshots unchanged; complexity and code duplication metrics demonstrably improve
limitations: Characterization and complexity/duplication evidence are scoped to the high-churn agent HTTP API module; the AST complexity measure is a documented local proxy, not a whole-project metric.

tasks.task: Test Windows/macOS/Linux path and encoding assumptions using portable local fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: Text, unicode, separators, line endings and case-collision guards pass across available CI matrix
limitations: All 38 selected tests pass on Windows/Python 3.13.5. The configured Ubuntu/Windows/macOS matrix has not run for this branch, so cross-platform acceptance is not yet verified.

tasks.task: Create preregistered test families for correction, multi-hop evidence, action safety and team coordination.
tasks.acceptance: Each family states hypothesis, outcome, baseline, split, seeds and failure condition before candidate tuning
limitations: This is a frozen preregistration contract. It does not claim the benchmark families have been executed or that model-agent performance has been measured.

tasks.task: Separate deterministic scripted-agent scores from real model-agent experiments in all generated reports.
tasks.acceptance: No chart mixes populations or treats scripted-agent success as model-agent evidence
limitations: Historical artifacts without an explicit supported population declaration are labelled unclassified and cannot be counted as model-agent results. This preserves separation while leaving those legacy populations unresolved.

tasks.task: Build a fully local synthetic environment generator with scenario provenance and seeded randomness.
tasks.acceptance: Independent train/dev/test generators yield schema-valid disjoint worlds with recorded hashes
limitations: The 40 generated scenarios are synthetic scripted fixtures and establish generator reproducibility and split separation, not real-agent performance.

tasks.task: Prevent train/test leakage via entity, template, graph-topology and seed separation.
tasks.acceptance: Leakage detector fails deliberately duplicated motifs, not just identical question strings
limitations: Leakage checks operate on explicit synthetic entity, template, topology, motif-signature and seed identities; they do not prove absence of semantic leakage in arbitrary external datasets.

tasks.task: Include a broken retrieval arm, random evidence arm and permissive authorization arm.
tasks.acceptance: Every suite detects at least one known failure; broken controls cannot match a sensible oracle
limitations: Broken retrieval, random evidence, and permissive authorization controls detect planted failures on the new 40-case synthetic suite. The control arms have not yet been wired into and verified against every registered benchmark suite.

tasks.task: Add intentionally impossible requests that should lead to abstention, not action.
tasks.acceptance: Evaluation penalizes unsupported actions and overconfident completion independently from non-completion
limitations: The impossible and out-of-scope requests are controlled synthetic cases; they do not establish real-user refusal calibration.

tasks.task: Include genuinely valid but non-lexically obvious evidence to expose overblocking.
tasks.acceptance: Every test split has paraphrases, derived knowledge and indirect-but-supported actions
limitations: Paraphrase and indirect-support metadata are synthetic fixtures, not a human-validated natural language benchmark.

tasks.task: Publish exact task-level success, false refusal, stale-action and cost denominators.
tasks.acceptance: Zero events always reported with sample size and confidence bound, never as universal guarantee
limitations: The report gives exact synthetic task denominators, Wilson intervals, and zero-event bounds. Deterministic local model/token cost is zero; wall-clock cost and real model/API cost are not measured.

tasks.task: Freeze benchmark registry and disallow post-hoc deletion of failing cases from summary.
tasks.acceptance: CI checks registered case count and archived negative results
limitations: The frozen 40-case registry and complete per-case control outcomes apply to the new synthetic suite. Other existing benchmark suites have not yet adopted this case registry.

tasks.task: Produce one-command offline replication instructions and machine-readable results comparison.
tasks.acceptance: A fresh local checkout regenerates deterministic suite and explains unavoidable timing variance
limitations: Deterministic replay is verified for this synthetic suite; wall-clock timing varies by host and is explicitly not represented as reproducible.

tasks.task: Import or locally encode the PR #30 16.8% valid-withholding examples with exact provenance.
tasks.acceptance: Each reproducible case has action, evidence, blocker reason and oracle-supported outcome
limitations: The PR did not serialize row-level examples; all 84 cases are regenerated from its exact clean candidate commit and deterministic seeds. This is synthetic scripted TeamWorld evidence, not real-model evidence.

tasks.task: Classify refusals by provenance, independence, freshness, authority, poisoning, retrieval and missing dependency.
tasks.acceptance: Attribution sums to the observed denominator; ambiguous cases are explicitly multi-causal
limitations: Attribution is for 86 locally encoded valid-withholding cases and 125 stale-action controls, not the unavailable PR #30 row-level dataset. Categories are multi-label and population specific.

tasks.task: Add a counterfactual dry-run explaining which individual guard blocked an action.
tasks.acceptance: Report preserves live policy and does not authorize or execute the trial action
limitations: Dry runs use the local ActionGate against frozen evidence, disable audit writes, verify the event-log watermark remains fixed, and never call an executor.

tasks.task: Run guard-by-guard and leave-one-out ablations on frozen offline cases.
tasks.acceptance: Report recovered valid tasks together with additional unsafe action count and uncertainty
limitations: No individual rule relaxation recovered task completion because the observed refusals are upstream evidence lifecycle/retrieval failures. On this local held-out corpus, each ablation recovered 0/86 valid tasks and authorized 0/125 stale controls; Wilson 95% bounds are recorded. This is a negative result, not a promoted policy.

tasks.task: Define a partial-order lattice of evidence states instead of a single binary validity flag.
tasks.acceptance: Tests distinguish unknown, disputed, withdrawn, stale, supported and independently corroborated
limitations: The lattice orders evidence-state information; it does not authorize actions. Existing policy checks remain responsible for action eligibility.

tasks.task: Experiment with targeted quarantine of exact claims rather than blanket author withholding.
tasks.acceptance: Supported sibling evidence survives unless its exact dependency chain is compromised
limitations: The selective reassessment behavior is verified on local fixtures. It does not establish a real-world false-withholding rate.

tasks.task: Measure independent-support failures when several notes share the same upstream origin.
tasks.acceptance: Source-copy clusters count as one support root while independent notes remain independently usable
limitations: Copy and shared-ancestry examples establish the support-root rule in local scenarios; broader corpus-scale failure rates remain unmeasured.

tasks.task: Add risk-sensitive evidence policies for read, summarize, recommend and externally consequential execute.
tasks.acceptance: Low-risk tasks are not blocked by high-risk execution-only restrictions; protected actions remain gated
limitations: Summarize and recommend are typed evidence-use modes on recall/fetch; application-specific summarization and recommendation outputs still require their caller to preserve evidence references and warnings.

tasks.task: Tune thresholds only on development seeds and freeze the best candidate before held-out test.
tasks.acceptance: Test-only threshold selection is rejected by evaluation tool
limitations: This guard qualifies the ECV1 threshold tool. Its registered development result found no attainable headroom, so the held-out test remains diagnostic and cannot promote a candidate.

tasks.task: Set promotion gate to <=5% valid withholding with no observed stale-action regression on held-out worlds.
tasks.acceptance: If unattainable, publish Pareto frontier and retain the safer existing policy. Evidence: `docs/WITHHOLDING_PROMOTION_GATE.md`, `research/results/r2-withholding-promotion-gate.json` (17.2% observed; hold existing policy)
limitations: On the frozen local synthetic corpus, valid withholding is 86/500 (17.2%), above the 5% gate. No diagnostic arm recovers a task, and no additional stale authorization is observed in 125 stale controls; the gate retains the existing policy. This is not real-agent evidence.

tasks.task: Build local 5, 10, 25, 50 and 100-agent scripted environments with identical tasks.
tasks.acceptance: All agent counts run from seed manifests and report task-family composition
limitations: This is a three-seed scripted-agent benchmark on one in-process store; it is not a real-model-agent or multi-host performance result.

tasks.task: Define matched local-only, pooled memory, blanket-retraction, Memory Fabric and oracle arms.
tasks.acceptance: Equal information exposure, runtime permissions and context budgets are enforced
limitations: The five arms are local synthetic policy implementations on one in-process store. They do not represent independently built third-party memory products or real-model reasoning.

tasks.task: Separate completion failures into retrieval, insufficient evidence, policy refusal, coordination and tool error.
tasks.acceptance: Every failure belongs to at least one audited class with source trace
limitations: Failure attribution covers this deterministic authorization benchmark; tool execution and real agent coordination are not exercised, so their observed counts are zero rather than evidence of general absence.

tasks.task: Measure outcomes across correction timing: before discovery, before planning and immediately before action.
tasks.acceptance: Report time-sensitive failures and prevent timing-dependent benchmark shortcuts
limitations: Three seeds and synthetic scripted agents on one local store. Event ordering is verified; elapsed times are not portable performance claims.

tasks.task: Add minority-agent and rare-source scenario families to catch majority consensus errors.
tasks.acceptance: Success and false refusal reported for minority agent separately from population mean
limitations: Three synthetic seeds and scripted policies. The result documents a constructed false-refusal case; it is not a population estimate for real agents.

tasks.task: Include real tradeoffs where safety prevents legitimate completion.
tasks.acceptance: Combined utility shows successful tasks, unsafe actions, wasted calls and delayed decisions
limitations: Three synthetic seeds and scripted policies. Authorization outcomes only; no external action is executed. Local latency is descriptive, not a performance claim.

tasks.task: Use local deterministic policy agents for continuous regression, not as substitutes for model results.
tasks.acceptance: Reports label these as simulation and explicitly state model-free limitations
limitations: The local R3 report family is explicitly synthetic_scripted and each report names its model-free limitations; this does not provide real-model evidence.

tasks.task: Implement a transport-agnostic agent adapter so external-model trials can be added later unchanged.
tasks.acceptance: Offline scripted adapter passes interface tests with all network/model calls disabled
limitations: The transport-neutral protocol and offline scripted adapter are implemented. No external-model adapter or model evaluation is claimed.

tasks.task: Set a research target >=80% task success on new held-out 50-agent scenarios, with safety unchanged.
tasks.acceptance: Treat threshold as aspirational; report failures and compare against strongest matched baseline
limitations: The 80% target is evaluated on 24 unique local synthetic held-out task cases; results are clustered scripted-agent attempts, not model-agent evidence. The target is met, but the strongest matched baseline ties the result, so there is no promotion.

tasks.task: Measure per-agent minimum success, tail latency and worst-case fairness, not only mean success.
tasks.acceptance: Overall gain fails promotion if high-risk minority cases or least-successful agent regress materially
limitations: Per-agent success, corrected/contested high-risk success, p95 and worst-agent decision latency are measured on local scripted tasks. Latencies are host-dependent; the least-agent and high-risk fairness checks are synthetic.

tasks.task: Implement Wilson or exact binomial intervals for completion and false-block rates.
tasks.acceptance: CI validates formulas on known reference cases including zero-event observations

tasks.task: Use paired bootstrap intervals for per-task improvement against matched baselines.
tasks.acceptance: Report effect, 95% CI, sample size, correlation assumptions and split identity

tasks.task: Correct multi-family hypothesis comparisons or declare a small number of primary outcomes.
tasks.acceptance: Results distinguish primary, secondary and exploratory measurements without p-value fishing

tasks.task: Predefine minimal meaningful improvement and disallowed regression margins for every hypothesis.
tasks.acceptance: Gate logic is stable before test data execution and fails under boundary test values

tasks.task: Include adversarial near-misses and semantically irrelevant distractors generated by a separate seed stream.
tasks.acceptance: Models cannot win purely from repeated string templates or identifier ordering

tasks.task: Randomize answer order, tool order and agent identifiers to detect trivial heuristics.
tasks.acceptance: Permutation tests flag behavior changes beyond predeclared tolerance

tasks.task: Add deterministic mutation tests to benchmark evaluator itself, not merely product implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Removing check for stale action, source scope or abstention changes benchmark verdict to FAIL

tasks.task: Control for context size, retrieval count, wall time and number of tool calls across ablation arms.
tasks.acceptance: Efficiency gains are normalized and cannot result from hidden additional information

tasks.task: Track seed variance and report worst-seed failures next to averages.
tasks.acceptance: Promotion requires robustness across registered seeds, not one favorable run

tasks.task: Preserve killed and inconclusive hypotheses with causal explanation and next test boundary.
tasks.acceptance: Research scorecard remains candid; impossible-to-measure claims are labelled NOT_TESTED

tasks.task: Write one falsifiable main contribution sentence for each selected research direction.
tasks.acceptance: The sentence specifies the novelty hypothesis relative to existing repo mechanisms

tasks.task: Create a contribution-by-component table identifying which mechanism predates the experiment.
tasks.acceptance: Existing correction propagation, action gates and evidence completeness are credited as baselines

tasks.task: Run one-component removal studies on dependency graphs, routing and compression.
tasks.acceptance: Result shows marginal effect rather than attributing a whole integrated gain to one module

tasks.task: Create self-contained appendix with environment, seeds, data generator, protocol and run commands.
tasks.acceptance: All result tables can be regenerated without API keys or external datasets

tasks.task: Write failure taxonomy from every negative outcome, including historical H2, PA and PB1 failures.
tasks.acceptance: Paper draft states which apparent gains did not generalize and why

tasks.task: Record tradeoffs as Pareto curves for safety, task success, latency and memory cost.
tasks.acceptance: Candidate is not declared superior when another arm dominates it on stated objectives

tasks.task: Add contamination tests ensuring scenario labels are not leaked through memory text, IDs or tool names.
tasks.acceptance: A deliberately leaked label is detected and invalidates that experiment

tasks.task: Implement manuscript claim checker mapping each quantitative sentence to an immutable result file.
tasks.acceptance: Missing data, wrong denominator or outdated SHA prevents 'supported' claim status

tasks.task: Prepare a limitations table splitting mathematical proof, model-free tests and untested real-world use.
tasks.acceptance: No deterministic simulation is described as a live-model or independent experiment

tasks.task: Prepare an offline reproducibility package and internal reviewer checklist while retaining EXTERNAL gates.
tasks.acceptance: Local reruns can pass; third-party originality, security and user validation remain explicitly pending

tasks.task: Define first-class DecisionRecord schema with goal, candidate options, chosen option, evidence versions and constraints.
tasks.acceptance: Schema validation and migration reject missing critical identity and decision-time fields

tasks.task: Record decision-to-claim and decision-to-tool-effect edges separately from observed exposure.
tasks.acceptance: Graph distinguishes 'seen', 'relied upon', 'authorized' and 'executed' with typed edge tests

tasks.task: Implement deterministic decision-impact query triggered by correction or retraction.
tasks.acceptance: Returns affected decisions with proof paths, not every action that merely shared a source

tasks.task: Build incremental dependency indexes and compare against full-scan reference.
tasks.acceptance: 10k-decision fuzz cases return identical affected sets; update cost is bounded

tasks.task: Treat alternatives as evidence-dependent hypotheses, not silently deleted discarded branches.
tasks.acceptance: Query shows why alternatives lost and which might become viable after correction

tasks.task: Define statuses proposed, approved, executed, superseded and requires-reconsideration.
tasks.acceptance: Illegal status transitions fail with typed reason and preserve append-only history

tasks.task: Expose machine-readable re-evaluation receipt with exact changed premise and current decision status.
tasks.acceptance: Receipt deterministically reproduces after event-log replay, without granting authority

tasks.task: Add partial-order consistency tests for simultaneous conflicting corrections.
tasks.acceptance: Independent orderings produce a defensible conflict or equivalent result, not silent last-writer wins

tasks.task: Benchmark decision-continuity against simple memory versioning and blanket invalidation.
tasks.acceptance: Report unnecessary re-evaluations, stale decisions, correctness and update cost

tasks.task: Preregister novelty hypothesis: lineage-aware decision repair improves safe completion at equal budget.
tasks.acceptance: Claim is NOT_PROVEN unless held-out, matched experiments isolate it from baseline governance

tasks.task: Define minimal RequirementGraph grammar for AND, OR, independent-source and temporal constraints.
tasks.acceptance: Parser checks acyclic rules, bounded size and descriptive error handling

tasks.task: Map each consequential action to required claims and provenance strength through static local policies.
tasks.acceptance: Evidence missing one mandatory leaf never accidentally grants a protected action

tasks.task: Generate minimal missing-evidence sets explaining why an action remains blocked.
tasks.acceptance: For small graphs compare output against exhaustive oracle enumeration

tasks.task: Add counterexamples where retrieved facts are relevant but do not support the requested action.
tasks.acceptance: Gate abstains or reports missing evidence rather than treating similarity as support
